title: MoveOpening Command
description: Slide an opening along its host facade segment. Provide delta_mm or absolute t, not both. Id omitted uses the current selection (exactly one opening_marker).

id.description: Opening marker GUID. Omit to use the current selection.

delta_mm.description: Signed distance along the segment tangent in mm. Exclusive with t.

t.description: Absolute placement along the segment, 0–1. Exclusive with delta_mm.
